scope.independence: No authorship of chemical primary proposals; subordinate scientific source cross-check for parent final skeptical adjudication.

case_reviews.assessment: BD 215530 is explicitly D(+)-glucose anhydrous on the captured official product page. The bounded catalog alias on D-glucose is supported; no monohydrate, ring-anomer or rejected tombstone revival is justified.
JCM 673 names Nacalai iron powder at 20–60 mesh; the captured Nacalai 19418-25 page gives Fe, CAS 7439-89-6 and that particle range. Bulk iron(0) is supported, not an iron atom identity.

DSMZ 1565 names disodium tartrate with two waters but no stereochemistry. The inspected CHEBI:63017 term is explicitly L-tartrate and lacks those waters. No exact routing to that term is supported; retain the actual missing stereoisomer fact.

TOGO M3211 preserves NaCOOH both as a component literal and in quoted recipe prose. The component caption identifies sodium formate; the source stock preparation prose does not change the identity of the weighed solute label. Alias support is bounded to this literal, not every stock solution.
TOGO M2553 explicitly writes So(Sulfur Powder), supplying grams of sulfur powder. Elemental sulfur is supported; neither a sulfur atom nor a specific allotrope follows.

Five full NBRC recipes explicitly write one water in Thiamine-HCl·H2O. This refutes exact routing to the existing anhydrous or dihydrate owner. Whether a source-qualified local monohydrate identity can now be curated remains a completeness question sent to the parent; lack of CAS alone is not a valid blocker under section 3 step 3.

TOGO M3161 preserves RibofIavin and labels the vitamin riboflavin. Separately, DSMZ1157 and NBRC1604 explicitly dose concentration-labelled riboflavin aliquots. Correcting the glyph alias while rejecting those stock labels on the neat molecular owner is supported.

All three TOGO rows M3120, M2367 and M2277 retain MnCI2.4H2O and caption manganese chloride tetrahydrate. The four-water identity is supported and the uppercase-I glyph is a transcription variant, not an iodide compound.
TOGO M3129 names ground sulfur powder in both original recipe prose and the ingredient row. The bounded alias belongs to elemental sulfur without an atom/allotrope assertion.

P5 distinguishes the Niacin (B3) solute from its single stock. The captured nicotinic-acid term includes niacin, whereas CHEBI:32544 explicitly denotes its charge-minus-one conjugate base. Rejecting Nicotinate only as a neutral-acid identity alias is supported.

Both DSMZ524 and623 omit hydration/catalog for Na-meta silicate. The missing hydrate is a genuine exact-routing limitation; omission is not evidence of anhydrous material. No assertion that the source reagent differs from every known hydrate is justified.

P5 distinguishes Thiamine HCl (B1) solute from its stock. The inspected CHEBI49105 nomenclature directly includes thiamine HCl. This does not authorize the explicitly one-water NBRC cases to resolve to the same owner.

The official TCI G0170 page supplies guanine hydrochloride formula and CAS but also permits drying loss; it is a comparator without a bridge to the historical CDM/LP reagent. Neither free-base identity nor a particular supplied hydrate is established. Failed historical retrieval is not negative evidence.

The full Oxoid LP0029 specification describes a refined meat-extract powder and its physical/chemical limits. This supports promotion of the existing Lab-Lemco powder product handle without a complete molecular recipe or equivalence to Lab-Lemco Broth.

NBRC1507 independently writes Thiamine-HCl·H2O in its vitamin preparation. The positive one-water detail must remain; the same local-monohydrate feasibility question as case10 is referred to the parent.

TOGO M2313 specifies chitin from shrimp shells as one alternative substrate. The preparation registry and partial chitin component are supported; purity, polymorph and exact processing are not provided. This is not equivalence to pure generic chitin.

CCAP PER directly identifies Complan supplied by HJ Heinz and UM independently names Complan without a supplier. Preserving the existing product-family handle with a supplier-scoped supplied form is supported; the current Original formula cannot be backfilled as historical composition.

The primary 2000 abstract and full relevant 2001 taxonomic report identify the former Pediococcus ISK-1 producer as Staphylococcus warneri ISK-1. The previous producer-name separation premise is false. The inspected CHEBI204272 structure/mass does not establish the primary mature 27-residue peptide, so exact promotion remains unsupported.

The original MediaDive1423 row and DSMZ1565 source specify dihydrate but no stereoisomer. They support the same bounded no-exact-L-tartrate conclusion as case3, without inventing a second source identity.

DSMZ1155 uses KJ as a 1mg/ml aliquoted stock and DSMZ1727 repeats KJ without spelling its identity. The separate DSMZ792b KI0.01% w/v aliquot positively supports the stock-alias rejection on neat potassium iodide. It does not settle the KJ reagent or solvent.

The frozen PYG record already has a mixture registry owner and 114 source-material holds. DSMZ104 demonstrates a concrete modified PYG and strain variations, not a bridge to the Bergey observations. Keeping their exact formulation unresolved does not require a duplicate owner.

The inspected CHEBI9532 and18290 records differ by chloride, formula, charge and CAS cross-reference. Removing chloride structural carryover from the9532 candidate is supported. CAS136-09-4 is not the inspected chloride CAS154-87-0; retaining its separate unresolved protonation review is necessary. No release or worker09 resolution is granted.

The scanned manufacturer petition pages1,4,9 explicitly bind CAS20846-91-7 to S,S-EDDS free acid; PubChem497266 is stereospecific. The frozen metatraits node gives no stereochemical or supplier bridge. Source-level exact transfer remains unsupported; the existing owner does not need duplicating.

MediaDive77 explicitly names the dihydrate and CHEBI132751 preserves it. The direct PubChem response for CAS13465-05-9 contains ClH5O2 and no thiamine skeleton. Withdrawing that CAS without fabricating a replacement is supported; other held claims remain held.

The GTDB-metatraits literal supplies no chemical structure or product provenance. PubChem96241 leaves its anomeric center unspecified, so it does not establish the exact alpha-labelled source glycoside. Preserve the existing source handle and actual structure gap.

Solution3183 separates Eisencitrat as a 1g input from citric acid and water; this does not establish iron oxidation, stoichiometry or hydration. Separately TOGOM565 doses5ml Ferric citrate0.1%w/v and supports rejecting that stock label on the neat owner only. Inherited Eisencitrat routing is not newly approved.

The independent GTDB-metatraits EDDS node likewise lacks a stereochemical bridge to manufacturer S,S-EDDS. A lexical hit or historical approval of another owner does not supply that missing assay provenance.

The metatraits alpha-glucopyranoside node lacks anomeric structure/aglycon/product provenance. The unspecified-anomer PubChem comparator does not resolve it. Registry retention is supported, with no exact external molecular promotion.
